pages.text: Your character has three layers of identity:$(br2)$(bold)Layer 1 — Origin$() (what species you are)$(br)13 unique species with flavor powers like flight, phasing, or wall-climbing. Permanent.$(br2)$(bold)Layer 2 — Race$() (what people you belong to)$(br)11 races with stat modifiers and thematic traits. Permanent.$(br2)$(bold)Layer 3 — Class$() (what you do in combat)$(br)10 combat roles with HP modifiers, weapon affinities, and active abilities. Respec-able via Class Altar.

$(bold)How They Stack$()$(br2)All three layers stack additively. A $(thing)Blazeborn$() / $(thing)Orc$() / $(thing)Berserker$() is a fire-immune melee monster. A $(thing)Phantom$() / $(thing)Faefolk$() / $(thing)Archmage$() is an unkillable glass cannon.$(br2)$(bold)Origins$() provide unique abilities (flavor layer).$(br)$(bold)Races$() provide stat modifiers (identity layer).$(br)$(bold)Classes$() provide combat roles (gameplay layer).

$(bold)Respeccing$()$(br2)$(bold)Origins and Races are permanent.$() Choose carefully at character creation.$(br2)$(bold)Classes can be changed$() at a $(bold)Class Altar$() — a craftable station requiring a tier-appropriate boss drop + 30 XP levels. Skill points are not lost when respeccing.$(br2)$(bold)The 'Half Equipment HP' Rule$()$(br2)$(thing)Ranger$(), $(thing)Archmage$(), and $(thing)Void Summoner$() receive only 50% effectiveness from equipment-sourced max HP bonuses (Vitality enchant, HP affixes, armor attributes). Base HP, food HP, and level-up HP are unaffected.
